    "A blues or roots connection makes an album interesting, but that alone does not make it something I would choose on this visit."

  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest interaction with You Should Be So Lucky makes music connected to Tom Petty and the Heartbreakers especially relevant now.",
    "Today I am drawn to less familiar studio material with strong guitar playing and a clear connection to artists I have recently explored; other appealing albums can wait."
